How it works

At the end of some stations you come back to this map. Every station has parts. In part 1 you look everything up in your atlas or on a map website and answer some questions. In part 2 you put it all on the map. The map tells you if you are right. Every place you find clears a bit of the fog.

Zoom with two fingers or with the + and − buttons.

Your map is saved on this iPad. You can close the page. When you come back, your map is still here.

    Keep your map safe

    Save your game in your English folder on the iPad. If the iPad forgets your map, you can load it again.

    Map: painted with an image AI on a template from Natural Earth data (public domain). Coastlines, borders and the checks use the Natural Earth data.
